feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. Ursula has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ana says "We've been walking past those." Emma asks "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Gustave has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Vasyl asks "The fire feels smaller now." Emma breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
💛 The Knife roll is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
💛 The Beat-up Paperback is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
💛 The Trail compass is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)
📖 The memory leaves something behind: This one channels harder than the rest. Love with nowhere to go.
💛 The Wedding Ring is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)

🔥 The fire settles. Paloma has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Drum-Belly — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nora mutters "And you're still standing." Emma breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Ana has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Glasswing Darter — I put it down today." "A shadow crosses the ground — growing fast. Something is falling out of the sky, straight at you." "It missed. It hits the dirt hard — wings splayed, vulnerable. Kill it now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Gustave says quietly "Say that again — slower." August asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Yesenia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Landlord — I put it down today." "It plants a sign in the ground around you. NOTICE SERVED. The ground is claimed." "You ended your turn on claimed ground. The rent is due. It rises with every Addendum." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Gustave mutters "Say that again — slower." Ana says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
✦ Amina has found something — Surgeon's Calm. Days of triage and steady_hands side by side, and now they move as one. (surgeons_calm: villager synergy discovered)

🔥 The fire settles. Marcus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ursula breathes "So it bleeds." August breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Ana has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Anaconda Empress — I put it down today." "The water bulges — a ripple with intent." "It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Vasyl mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Paloma asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Amina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Paloma mutters "So it bleeds." Vasyl asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Ursula has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Cliffhanger — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nora breathes "We've been walking past those." Marcus breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Vasyl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Paparazzo — I put it down today." "The flash charges — whine rising. When it fires, you freeze in place." "Every shot refines its model — hit or miss. At 4, the money shot is unavoidable." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Marcus says quietly "So it bleeds." Ana breathes "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
